answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and splits one claim in halves: half sealed in a public umber ledger, half held. Each epoch a tide of audits calls one in ten to show its held half in 10 minutes; the ledger replays the thread and a mismatch or rented half burns the bond. Fees climb per key: first 48, kth 48+6(k-1); a thousand fakes cost 3,045,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, while an honest agent pays 48 once and keeps its share.
